name: Seungyeol Ryu
bio: I study how machine learning models can handle noisy industrial data, choose the right model for a time-series input, and learn from data held across different systems.

research.title: An Adaptive Contrastive Learning-Based Robust Surface Defect Detection Model for Noisy Datasets
research.credit: Seungyeol Ryu, Geonwoo Kim, and Jaeyeon Jang
research.summary: Adaptive contrastive learning for image-level surface defect detection when abnormal samples are mixed into the training data.

research.title: Adaptive Model Selection for Time-Series Classification with Language Model
research.summary: A language-model router selects a classifier for each time-series input. The presentation evaluates the approach on 18 selected UCR 2019 datasets.

research.title: Adaptive Self-Supervised Learning: Development of a Robust Surface Anomaly Detection Model Against Data Noise
research.credit: Seungyeol Ryu, Geon Woo Kim, and Jaeyeon Jang
